comment: Digital analogue PLL: edge phase-frequency detector, damped PI loop filter and phase-accumulator VCO.

params.name: Speed
params.comment: Loop natural frequency: 0.5 + 7.5 * (Speed/100)^2 Hz. Speed 100 is 8 Hz; Speed 1000 is 750.5 Hz.

params.name: Damping
params.comment: Damping ratio zeta: 0.1 + 1.8972087 * knob. Default 32 preserves the previous zeta=0.707.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Shared level for multiplied and divided PLL voices; 0 to unity.

params.name: Mult
params.comment: Eight fixed choices: 1x..8x; raw values 0..7 select each multiplier.

params.name: Div
params.comment: Eight fixed choices: 1/1..1/8; raw values 0..7 select each divider.

params.name: HiLvl
params.comment: Output level of the multiplied high voice; 0..100%.

params.name: LoLvl
params.comment: Output level of the input-edge-divided low voice; 0..100%.
